text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I would win this time...
And after
all those long hours of
training...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: ゆっくりでも前には進めてるよ
勝つ日のことを考えよう！
choice_data_list_en: Even if it's slow, you're still moving forward.
Let's think about the day we win!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I've noticed my
improvement during
training, and I'm
definitely performing better than
I did in
my first race...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be okay now! Even if it's slow, I know
I'm still
making progress, little by little!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll work even harder starting today. I'm
counting
on your guidance!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Feeling sorry for myself isn't going to
help me
improve. I have to keep running
and have faith
that I'll win someday!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! I'm ready to get
back to work!
